description: Email/parse is a major RFC 8621 method not yet implemented. Parses an arbitrary RFC 5322 blob (not stored as Email) and returns an Email-shaped object with null metadata fields (id, blobId, threadId, mailboxIds, keywords, receivedAt) and populated header/body fields. Uses the same property selection as Email/get including bodyStructure, textBody, bodyValues, fetchTextBodyValues etc. This is where jmap-mime comes in: parse_email() in the backend, then convert with message_to_jmap_body(). jmap-test-suite: parse-valid-message, parse-null-metadata, parse-not-found, parse-not-parsable, parse-body-values, parse-response-structure.
